pyqgis_plugin.name: PostGIS Manager
pyqgis_plugin.description: Unique spatial-database GIS toolkit for PostGIS — geometry editor, CRS audit, spatial join GUI, data-quality scoring, pgRouting network wizard, WFS, GPX import.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Hybrid QGIS 4 plugin and standalone app filling the gap QGIS leaves in spatial database management. Map viewer with geometry editor, CRS browser/audit, spatial join GUI, data-quality dashboard, pgRouting network wizard, WFS connector, GPX import, thematic classification and snapshot diff — plus full SQL/import/export/backup tooling. Bilingual EN/KA, light/dark themes.

pyqgis_plugin.about: Remove all layers except base layers and add Google Satellite Hybrid and OpenStreetMap

pyqgis_plugin.name: Calculate Geometry
pyqgis_plugin.description: Guided dialog to populate fields with geometry properties (coordinates, area, perimeter, length) — no expressions required.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Pick target field(s), a geometry property per field, a unit, and a CRS, then write the values in place. Built on existing QGIS core classes. Early experimental release — not yet extensively tested. Upstream QGIS feature request: https://github.com/qgis/QGIS/issues/66902
